jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a single battered canvas lineman's tool bag worn as a backpack, heavy brown duck cloth gone dark with oil, leather straps and corners, a coil of copper wire and the rubber handles of insulated pliers poking from its open top, a pair of rubber gloves clipped to one strap, plain, no lettering, no badge. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
